security_audit.summary: The static command, network, environment, sensitive-file, and reconnaissance matches are false positives from Markdown examples and normal FastAPI template code. Manual review found no prompt injection, but the template includes risky security defaults for CORS, user record authorization, and SQL logging.

remediation.issue: Wildcard CORS is enabled with credentials in the production template.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit allowed origins from configuration and disable credentials unless the application needs cookie-based browser authentication.

remediation.issue: The read_user endpoint allows authenticated users to fetch other user records by id.
remediation.suggestion: Add an ownership or role check before returning user records, or remove this endpoint and direct users to /me.

remediation.issue: SQLAlchemy echo=True is used in the main database template.
remediation.suggestion: Set SQL echo from a debug setting that defaults to false outside local development and test environments.

semantic_findings.title: Overbroad CORS Configuration
semantic_findings.description: The production template configures wildcard CORS origins with credentials enabled. Deployed as written, this can allow credentialed browser requests from untrusted origins.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The code directly sets allow_origins to ["*"] and allow_credentials to True in the main application template. The surrounding text presents this as production-ready guidance.

semantic_findings.title: User Lookup Missing Authorization Check
semantic_findings.description: The read_user endpoint returns any user by id for any authenticated caller. The update and delete endpoints enforce ownership, which highlights the missing read authorization check.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The endpoint depends on get_current_user but does not compare current_user.id to user_id or check an administrative role before returning the record.

semantic_findings.title: SQL Query Logging Enabled In Production Template
semantic_findings.description: The main database engine is created with echo=True. Production SQL logging can expose query parameters, identifiers, and sensitive application data in logs.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The database setup is part of the primary application template, and echo=True is explicitly enabled. The risk depends on deployment log handling, so confidence is high but not absolute.

content.value_statement: FastAPI projects need reliable structure, async database patterns, authentication, and tests. This skill provides template guidance for scalable API services.
actual_capabilities: Defines a layered FastAPI project layout for routes, services, repositories, schemas, models, and core configuration.
Shows dependency injection patterns for database sessions, settings, and authenticated users.
Provides async SQLAlchemy setup with session lifecycle management and repository methods.
Outlines service layer patterns for user creation, password hashing, authentication, and updates.
Includes JWT authentication examples with token creation, password hashing, and current user resolution.
Demonstrates async pytest and httpx fixtures for endpoint integration tests.
limitations: The scanned package contains only SKILL.md, so referenced assets are not present in this report.
Security defaults need review before production use, especially CORS, authorization, and logging.
The examples assume common FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, Pydantic, jose, and pytest libraries.
It does not deploy services, create infrastructure, or manage database migrations directly.

use_cases.title: Start A New API Service
use_cases.description: Create an initial FastAPI structure with routes, schemas, services, repositories, and application configuration.

use_cases.title: Standardize Team Architecture
use_cases.description: Use consistent async patterns, dependency injection, and layered code organization across multiple services.

use_cases.title: Add Authentication Patterns
use_cases.description: Draft JWT token handling, password hashing, current user dependencies, and protected endpoint examples.

prompt_templates.title: Create A Basic FastAPI Layout
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a FastAPI project structure for a small REST API. Include routes, schemas, services, repositories, settings, and tests.

prompt_templates.title: Add Async Database Access
prompt_templates.prompt: Design async SQLAlchemy database setup for my FastAPI service. Include session dependencies, repository methods, and transaction handling.

prompt_templates.title: Implement Authentication Flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Add secure user authentication to this FastAPI architecture. Include password hashing, JWT issuance, current user dependencies, and protected routes.

prompt_templates.title: Review A Production API Template
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my FastAPI template for production readiness. Focus on async boundaries, dependency injection, authorization checks, testing, logging, and configuration safety.

output_examples.input: Create a new FastAPI project for user and item APIs.
output_examples.output: A layered project plan with app modules, versioned routers, Pydantic schemas, repository classes, service classes, and async test coverage.

output_examples.input: Add authentication to my FastAPI service.
output_examples.output: An implementation outline covering password hashing, access token creation, token validation, current user dependencies, and protected route behavior.

output_examples.input: Review my FastAPI architecture for production readiness.
output: Identifies unsafe defaults such as broad CORS, verbose SQL logging, and missing authorization checks.
Recommends configuration, testing, and routing changes that match FastAPI conventions.

best_practices: Ask for the target database, authentication model, and deployment environment before generating production code.
Treat security defaults as placeholders and replace them with environment-specific settings before release.
Keep route handlers thin by placing data access in repositories and business rules in services.
anti_patterns: Do not deploy the template unchanged without reviewing CORS, authorization, secret handling, and SQL logging.
Do not put business logic directly in route handlers when a service layer is available.
Do not mix synchronous database drivers with async route handlers in production APIs.

faq.question: Does this skill generate a complete working repository?
faq.answer: It provides project structures and code patterns. The scanned package does not include the referenced template assets.

faq.question: Which frameworks does it focus on?
faq.answer: It focuses on FastAPI with async SQLAlchemy, Pydantic settings, jose JWT tokens, passlib password hashing, pytest, and httpx.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Is the included CORS example production safe?
faq.answer: No. Restrict allowed origins and review credential settings before deploying browser-facing APIs.

faq.question: Does it include testing guidance?
faq.answer: Yes. It shows async pytest fixtures, an in-memory test database, httpx client setup, and endpoint test patterns.

faq.question: What should I customize first?
faq.answer: Customize settings, database configuration, authentication rules, CORS origins, logging, and authorization checks for your application.
